d: FIFA President Gianni Infantino has repeatedly spoken about the growth of women's football, record audiences and the sport's commercial potential. But when it comes to Women's World Cup prize money, the gap between the men's and women's tournaments remains a major point of contention. Now, players from 45 countries are seeking a stronger commitment from FIFA, with potential legal action also being explored. Rupha Ramani looks at the FIFA equal pay controversy, the FIFPRO demands and the growing pressure on football's governing body ahead of the 2027 Women's World Cup.
